description.p: A native dropdown terminal with persistent workspaces, tabs and split panes. Shells run on a session server, so closing the window never ends them and reconnecting shows the same state, locally or over SSH.

ul.li: Workspaces, tabs and split panes that survive closing the window
A dropdown window shown and hidden with a global shortcut, where the desktop allows it
SSH workspaces with verified host keys and file attachments
A conversation view for coding agents
